---
name: Profile problem
about: Report a profile that behaved outside its stated boundary or produced the wrong deliverable
title: 'Problem: '
labels: profile problem
---

## Which profile

Name the bot and link its directory.

## What you sent

The task or message you gave the bot. Quote it when you can.

## What the bot did

The observed behavior or the output you received. Quote the relevant part rather than summarizing it.

## What you expected instead

Describe the behavior the profile promises, and point to the section of `PROFILE.md` or `SETUP.md` that states it.

## Boundary check

- [ ] The bot took an action its profile forbids, such as approving its own work, merging, sending a message, or spending money.

## Setup details

Which integrations were connected, and whether the profile was installed by pasting the SETUP URL or configured by hand.
